verdict.rationale: Godot documents a public, object-oriented API for programmatic control. EditorInterface covers saving and loading scenes and inspecting or editing resources, and EditorScript _run() adds scripted editor actions, accessible from GDScript, C#, C++ or GDExtension. A documented CLI and a headless mode let an external agent run builds, exports and scripted editor automation, and a built-in GDScript language server gives external tooling a documented protocol to attach to. Most of this API runs in-process rather than as a remote service API, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. missing for 10: a documented remote/network control API (no OpenAPI spec), an official MCP server or agent-facing endpoint, and independent hands-on corroboration of agents driving the editor API end-to-end.
